title: Monitor CPU usage in real time
description: Collect and show the processor usage in real time over several samples.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-Counter
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Get-Counter -Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time' -SampleInterval {intervalSeconds} -MaxSamples {maxSamples} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty CounterSamples | Select-Object Timestamp,@{Name='CPU_Usage_%';Expression={[math]::Round($_.CookedValue,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

examples.description: Show every property of the first object returned. Select-Object * widens the output to show all columns. -First 1 limits it to the first result. Use this command to discover the available properties before filtering.

examples.command: Get-Counter -Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time' -SampleInterval 60 -MaxSamples 10 | Export-Csv C:\Temp\Export.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
examples.description: Export the results to a CSV file usable in Excel. -NoTypeInformation removes the metadata line. -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.
Count the objects returned. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min, Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and to validate results.

notes: Replaces Performance Monitor. Continuous = continuous monitoring until Ctrl+C. Values >80% point to a high load.

fr.title: Surveiller l'utilisation CPU en temps réel
fr.description: Collecte et affiche l'utilisation du processeur en temps réel avec plusieurs échantillons
fr.notes: Remplace Performance Monitor. Continuous = surveillance continue jusqu'à Ctrl+C. Valeurs >80% indiquent une charge élevée.

intervalSeconds.label: Intervalle (secondes)
intervalSeconds.description: Intervalle entre chaque échantillon en secondes
